posts.body:
Beginning and The End, the new album from Blurfnes, is coming soon on Hyard Records.

Two sides of one record

The album has 20 tracks, split down the middle: 10 calm and 10 chaos. One half takes its time, the other goes straight for the floor.

The cover tells the same story: a man in white and a masked figure in black, standing back to back.

Be the first to hear it

Pre-save the album and we'll email you as soon as it's out, along with news about the release.

Until then, catch up on the rest of the catalog:

  • Blurfnes on Hyard Records
  • All Hyard Records releases
